about.heading: Practical AI engineering and digital growth, built from the ground up.
about.description: TRIQON AI brings together three co-founders with a clear focus: turning modern AI engineering, workflow automation, and digital marketing into dependable tools that organizations and individuals can actually use.
about.audienceTag: Built for businesses, startups, and individuals
about.visionText: To become a trusted technology partner delivering practical, understandable AI and digital solutions for businesses and individuals.
